verdict.rationale: Rippling documents some natural-language interaction inside the product: building reports and dashboards with AI, a "Show me headcount vs plan" prompt, and employees asking questions and submitting qualifying life events via AI. The evidence does not show natural-language commands operating the product broadly, such as running payroll, onboarding, or changing permissions. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control across core admin actions (payroll, HR, IT workflows), detailed first-party docs on the AI command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.
